create.name: Insight Meditation Community of Washington
create.bio:
The Insight Meditation Community of Washington (IMCW) is one of the largest insight meditation communities in the United States, serving the greater Washington area across DC, Maryland and Virginia. Tara Brach founded it in 1997, and it still rests on the Theravada-rooted vipassana teachings she and many others brought west, with mindfulness as the core practice and a loving heart and clear seeing as the aim. A large body of trained teachers, staff and volunteers now runs it.

The scale is unusual: well over a hundred classes, retreats and gatherings each month, in person, online and hybrid. Drop-in meditation classes run morning, midday and evening; dharma class series range from first steps to close study of the suttas; and three silent week-long retreats each year, in spring, autumn and at New Year, are joined by daylongs and weekend retreats. There are Spiritual Friends groups, sanghas for particular communities and ages, one-to-one mentoring and secular courses in mindfulness and self-compassion. IMCW also looks after Seven Oaks, a retreat centre it is developing in the Blue Ridge foothills of Virginia, and shares a large free archive of talks and guided meditations.

courses.title: Meditation Retreats
courses.description: IMCW's retreat programme: daylong, weekend and longer retreats, plus three silent week-long retreats each year in spring, autumn and over the New Year, with daily talks, sitting and walking practice, and small-group meetings with a teacher.

free_resources.title: Drop-in Classes
free_resources.description: Several drop-in meditation classes every day, morning, midday and evening, online and in person or hybrid in DC, Maryland and Virginia, each led by an experienced teacher. Newcomers can simply turn up and will be shown the basics.

free_resources.title: Talks
free_resources.description: IMCW's library of recorded dharma talks and guided meditations, with an archive going back over ten years, a video series on the elements of practice with Tara Brach, and recorded conversations with visiting teachers.

free_resources.title: Learn to Meditate
free_resources.description: A starting page for beginners, with basic instruction from founder Tara Brach and pointers to nearby and online classes where newcomers are welcome.
